sanskrit: a̱bhi tyam me̱ṣam pu̍ruhū̱tam ṛ̱gmiya̱m indra̍ṁ gī̱rbhir ma̍datā̱ vasvo̍ arṇa̱vam | yasya̱ dyāvo̱ na vi̱cara̍nti̱ mānu̍ṣā bhu̱je maṁhi̍ṣṭham a̱bhi vipra̍m arcata ||
english: Sing forth with hymns to him, that ram much-invoked, lauded in song — Indra, the ocean of wealth — whose heavens men do not traverse to the end; praise the most bounteous one, the inspired, for our enjoyment.

sanskrit: a̱bhīm a̍vanvan svabhi̱ṣṭim ū̱tayo̍ 'ntarikṣa̱prāṁ tavi̍ṣībhi̱r āvṛ̍tam | indra̱ṁ dakṣā̍sa ṛ̱bhavo̍ mada̱cyuta̍ṁ śa̱takra̍tu̱ṁ java̍nī sū̱nṛtāru̍hat ||
english: His own aids did homage to him of self-might, him who fills mid-air, encompassed by his powers; the wise Ṛbhus exalted Indra, the intoxication-pouring, the hundred-thoughted — and swift Truth mounted up.

sanskrit: tvaṁ go̱tram aṅgi̍robhyo 'vṛṇo̱r apo̱tātra̍ye śa̱tadu̍reṣu gātu̱vit | sa̱sena̍ cid vima̱dāyā̍vaho̱ vasv ā̱jāv adri̍ṁ vāvasā̱nasya̍ na̱rtaya̍n ||
english: You cleft the cow-pen for the Aṅgiras; you found the path for Atri amid the hundred fortresses; even arrayed with battle-host you brought wealth to Vimada in the contest, and made the rock leap for him who pressed the Soma.

sanskrit: tvam a̱pām a̍pi̱dhānā̍vṛṇo̱r apādhā̍raya̱ḥ parva̍te̱ dānu̍ma̱d vasu̍ | vṛ̱traṁ yad i̍ndra̱ śava̱sāva̍dhī̱r ahi̱m ād it sūrya̍ṁ di̱vy āro̍hayo dṛ̱śe ||
english: You uncovered the covering of the waters and set flowing on the mountain the dripping treasure; when, O Indra, you slew with your might Vṛtra the serpent, you then raised the sun in the sky for all to see.

sanskrit: tvam mā̱yābhi̱r apa̍ mā̱yino̍ 'dhamaḥ sva̱dhābhi̱r ye adhi̱ śuptā̱v aju̍hvata | tvam pipro̍r nṛmaṇa̱ḥ prāru̍ja̱ḥ pura̱ḥ pra ṛ̱jiśvā̍naṁ dasyu̱hatye̍ṣv āvitha ||
english: You cast down the sorcerers with your own magic powers — those who poured oblations on the couch of sleep; you, O hero-minded, broke open the fortresses of Pipru; and you aided Ṛjiśvan in the slayings of the Dasyus.

sanskrit: tvaṁ kutsa̍ṁ śuṣṇa̱hatye̍ṣv āvi̱thāra̍ndhayo 'tithi̱gvāya̱ śamba̍ram | ma̱hānta̍ṁ cid arbu̱daṁ ni kra̍mīḥ pa̱dā sa̱nād e̱va da̍syu̱hatyā̍ya jajñiṣe ||
english: You aided Kutsa in the slayings of Śuṣṇa; you gave Śambara into the hand of Atithigva; you trod down with your foot even the great Arbuda — from of old you were born for the slaughter of the Dasyus.

sanskrit: tve viśvā̱ tavi̍ṣī sa̱dhrya̍g ghi̱tā tava̱ rādha̍ḥ somapī̱thāya̍ harṣate | tava̱ vajra̍ś cikite bā̱hvor hi̱to vṛ̱ścā śatro̱r ava̱ viśvā̍ni̱ vṛṣṇyā̍ ||
english: All strength is placed in you, directed to one aim; your bounty rejoices for the drinking of Soma; your thunderbolt held in both arms is well-known — cut away all the virile powers of the foe.

sanskrit: vi jā̍nī̱hy āryā̱n ye ca̱ dasya̍vo ba̱rhiṣma̍te randhayā̱ śāsa̍d avra̱tān | śākī̍ bhava̱ yaja̍mānasya codi̱tā viśvet tā te̍ sadha̱māde̍ṣu cākana ||
english: Distinguish the Āryas from the Dasyus; subdue for the Soma-strewer those who transgress the ordinances; be the mighty impeller of the sacrificer — all these things of yours please at the communal joys.

sanskrit: anu̍vratāya ra̱ndhaya̱nn apa̍vratān ā̱bhūbhi̱r indra̍ḥ śna̱thaya̱nn anā̍bhuvaḥ | vṛ̱ddhasya̍ ci̱d vardha̍to̱ dyām ina̍kṣata̱ḥ stavā̍no va̱mro vi ja̍ghāna sa̱ṁdiha̍ḥ ||
english: Subduing the lawless for him who follows the law, Indra with his own presences smites down those who grasp at nothing; being praised while still growing he reaches toward heaven even as the great grows greater — the ant Vamra struck apart the ones who coil.

sanskrit: takṣa̱d yat ta̍ u̱śanā̱ saha̍sā̱ saho̱ vi roda̍sī ma̱jmanā̍ bādhate̱ śava̍ḥ | ā tvā̱ vāta̍sya nṛmaṇo mano̱yuja̱ ā pūrya̍māṇam avahann a̱bhi śrava̍ḥ ||
english: Uśanā fashioned for you with might your mighty force; your power with its greatness pushes apart the two worlds; the coursers harnessed by thought and driven by the wind brought you, O hero-minded one, as you were being filled, toward fame.

sanskrit: mandi̍ṣṭa̱ yad u̱śane̍ kā̱vye sacā̱m̐ indro̍ va̱ṅkū va̍ṅku̱tarādhi̍ tiṣṭhati | u̱gro ya̱yiṁ nir a̱paḥ srota̍sāsṛja̱d vi śuṣṇa̍sya dṛṁhi̱tā ai̍raya̱t pura̍ḥ ||
english: Indra was gladdened when keeping company with the sage Uśanā Kāvya; the Vṛtra-destroying one stands even above the cunning; the fierce one let loose the waters with their streams and shook apart the established fortresses of Śuṣṇa.

sanskrit: ā smā̱ ratha̍ṁ vṛṣa̱pāṇe̍ṣu tiṣṭhasi śāryā̱tasya̱ prabhṛ̍tā̱ yeṣu̱ manda̍se | indra̱ yathā̍ su̱taso̍meṣu cā̱kano̍ 'na̱rvāṇa̱ṁ śloka̱m ā ro̍hase di̱vi ||
english: You take your stand in your chariot at the bull-handed ones, at the offerings of Śāryāta where you are gladdened; as, O Indra, you delight in pressed-Soma rites, you mount up to unimpeded glory in the sky.

sanskrit: ada̍dā̱ arbhā̍m maha̱te va̍ca̱syave̍ ka̱kṣīva̍te vṛca̱yām i̍ndra sunva̱te | menā̍bhavo vṛṣaṇa̱śvasya̍ sukrato̱ viśvet tā te̱ sava̍neṣu pra̱vācyā̍ ||
english: You gave the young Vṛcayā to the great eloquent Kakṣīvat who pressed the Soma, O Indra; you became the ally of Vṛṣaṇaśva, O good-powered one — all these deeds of yours are to be proclaimed at the pressings.

sanskrit: indro̍ aśrāyi su̱dhyo̍ nire̱ke pa̱jreṣu̱ stomo̱ duryo̱ na yūpa̍ḥ | a̱śva̱yur ga̱vyū ra̍tha̱yur va̍sū̱yur indra̱ id rā̱yaḥ kṣa̍yati praya̱ntā ||
english: Indra of good thought was celebrated alone at the Pajras; the praise-hymn like the sacrificial post at the house-door stands firm; seeking horses, desiring cattle, seeking chariots, desiring wealth — Indra alone rules over riches as their bestower.

sanskrit: i̱daṁ namo̍ vṛṣa̱bhāya̍ sva̱rāje̍ sa̱tyaśu̍ṣmāya ta̱vase̍ 'vāci | a̱sminn i̍ndra vṛ̱jane̱ sarva̍vīrā̱ḥ smat sū̱ribhi̱s tava̱ śarma̍n syāma ||
english: This homage has been spoken to the bull, the self-sovereign, him of true vigor, the powerful one; in this enclosed space, O Indra, together with all heroes, may we together with our patrons be in your shelter.

sanskrit: tyaṁ su me̱ṣam ma̍hayā sva̱rvida̍ṁ śa̱taṁ yasya̍ su̱bhva̍ḥ sā̱kam īra̍te | atya̱ṁ na vāja̍ṁ havana̱syada̍ṁ ratha̱m endra̍ṁ vavṛtyā̱m ava̍se suvṛ̱ktibhi̍ḥ ||
english: Magnify that ram, the finder of heaven, at whose side a hundred of his fine ones move; like a prize steed I would turn Indra toward us for aid with well-fashioned hymns — him who hears the call and swiftly comes like a chariot to the race.

sanskrit: sa parva̍to̱ na dha̱ruṇe̱ṣv acyu̍taḥ sa̱hasra̍mūti̱s tavi̍ṣīṣu vāvṛdhe | indro̱ yad vṛ̱tram ava̍dhīn nadī̱vṛta̍m u̱bjann arṇā̍ṁsi̱ jarhṛ̍ṣāṇo̱ andha̍sā ||
english: He, unshaken as a mountain in his foundations, of thousandfold help, has waxed great in his powers; when Indra slew Vṛtra who had dammed the rivers, he pressed the floods forth, exulting in the Soma-draught.

sanskrit: sa hi dva̱ro dva̱riṣu̍ va̱vra ūdha̍ni ca̱ndrabu̍dhno̱ mada̍vṛddho manī̱ṣibhi̍ḥ | indra̱ṁ tam a̍hve svapa̱syayā̍ dhi̱yā maṁhi̍ṣṭharāti̱ṁ sa hi papri̱r andha̍saḥ ||
english: He is the door-opener at doors, at the udder-like fountain of bright clarity, grown great in rapture by the wise ones; I call that Indra with well-working thought — the most bounteous giver, for he is the filler with the Soma-draught.

sanskrit: ā yam pṛ̱ṇanti̍ di̱vi sadma̍barhiṣaḥ samu̱draṁ na su̱bhva1̱̍ḥ svā a̱bhiṣṭa̍yaḥ | taṁ vṛ̍tra̱hatye̱ anu̍ tasthur ū̱taya̱ḥ śuṣmā̱ indra̍m avā̱tā ahru̍tapsavaḥ ||
english: Him whom, on the heavenly seat with Soma-strewn grass, his own fine aids fill like an ocean; him in the slaying of Vṛtra the vigorous aids followed — Indra's fierce, wind-swift, unerring helpers.

sanskrit: a̱bhi svavṛ̍ṣṭi̱m made̍ asya̱ yudhya̍to ra̱ghvīr i̍va prava̱ṇe sa̍srur ū̱taya̍ḥ | indro̱ yad va̱jrī dhṛ̱ṣamā̍ṇo̱ andha̍sā bhi̱nad va̱lasya̍ pari̱dhīm̐r i̍va tri̱taḥ ||
english: Toward his own rain-shower in the rapture of him fighting, the aids coursed swiftly as swift ones down a slope; when Indra the thunderbolt-bearer, bold in the Soma-draught, split apart the enclosures of Vala, even as Trita does.

sanskrit: parī̍ṁ ghṛ̱ṇā ca̍rati titvi̱ṣe śavo̱ 'po vṛ̱tvī raja̍so bu̱dhnam āśa̍yat | vṛ̱trasya̱ yat pra̍va̱ṇe du̱rgṛbhi̍śvano nija̱ghantha̱ hanvo̍r indra tanya̱tum ||
english: His force moves around amid heat and gleaming splendor; having encompassed the waters it lay down at the base of the atmosphere; when in the downward slope of Vṛtra, hard to seize and roaring, O Indra, you smote the thunder between his two jaws.

sanskrit: hra̱daṁ na hi tvā̍ nyṛ̱ṣanty ū̱rmayo̱ brahmā̍ṇīndra̱ tava̱ yāni̱ vardha̍nā | tvaṣṭā̍ cit te̱ yujya̍ṁ vāvṛdhe̱ śava̍s ta̱takṣa̱ vajra̍m a̱bhibhū̍tyojasam ||
english: As into a lake, the waves do not overwhelm you; the sacred formulas, O Indra, those that increase you — even Tvaṣṭṛ's matched power has grown great for you; he fashioned the thunderbolt of overwhelming force.

sanskrit: ja̱gha̱nvām̐ u̱ hari̍bhiḥ sambhṛtakrata̱v indra̍ vṛ̱tram manu̍ṣe gātu̱yann a̱paḥ | aya̍cchathā bā̱hvor vajra̍m āya̱sam adhā̍rayo di̱vy ā sūrya̍ṁ dṛ̱śe ||
english: Having slain Vṛtra with your bay steeds, your will gathered, O Indra, you opened the waters' path for Manu; you stretched out the iron thunderbolt from your two arms and fixed the sun in the sky for all to see.

sanskrit: bṛ̱hat svaśca̍ndra̱m ama̍va̱d yad u̱kthya1̱̍m akṛ̍ṇvata bhi̱yasā̱ roha̍ṇaṁ di̱vaḥ | yan mānu̍ṣapradhanā̱ indra̍m ū̱taya̱ḥ sva̍r nṛ̱ṣāco̍ ma̱ruto 'ma̍da̱nn anu̍ ||
english: Vast and self-shining with force, what is hymn-worthy — they made the ascent of heaven tremble in fear; when the human-battle aids of Indra, the man-rousing Maruts, followed him exulting toward the sun.

sanskrit: dyauś ci̍d a̱syāma̍vā̱m̐ ahe̍ḥ sva̱nād ayo̍yavīd bhi̱yasā̱ vajra̍ indra te | vṛ̱trasya̱ yad ba̍dbadhā̱nasya̍ rodasī̱ made̍ su̱tasya̱ śava̱sābhi̍na̱c chira̍ḥ ||
english: Even Heaven, which is forceful, shook away in fear from the roaring of the serpent; your thunderbolt, O Indra, quivered; when with the force of the pressed Soma you smashed the head of Vṛtra who had pressed the two worlds together.

sanskrit: yad in nv i̍ndra pṛthi̱vī daśa̍bhuji̱r ahā̍ni̱ viśvā̍ ta̱tana̍nta kṛ̱ṣṭaya̍ḥ ||
english: When, O Indra, the earth of ten degrees stretched out all the days, the peoples spread forth — in that, O Maghavan, your widely heard power became in its force a great thing co-extensive with heaven.

sanskrit: tvam a̱sya pā̱re raja̍so̱ vyo̍mana̱ḥ svabhū̍tyojā̱ ava̍se dhṛṣanmanaḥ | ca̱kṛ̱ṣe bhūmi̍m prati̱māna̱m oja̍so̱ 'paḥ sva̍ḥ pari̱bhūr e̱ṣy ā diva̍m ||
english: You, O bold-minded one, are on the far shore of this aerial realm, your own being's force ready to help; you have made the earth as the measure of your power; you who encompass the waters and the sun come to heaven.

sanskrit: tvam bhu̍vaḥ prati̱māna̍m pṛthi̱vyā ṛ̱ṣvavī̍rasya bṛha̱taḥ pati̍r bhūḥ | viśva̱m āprā̍ a̱ntari̍kṣam mahi̱tvā sa̱tyam a̱ddhā naki̍r a̱nyas tvāvā̍n ||
english: You have become the measure of the earth; you have become lord of the great one of lofty heroism; you have filled the entire mid-air with your greatness — truly indeed no other is like you.

sanskrit: na yasya̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī anu̱ vyaco̱ na sindha̍vo̱ raja̍so̱ anta̍m āna̱śuḥ | nota svavṛ̍ṣṭi̱m made̍ asya̱ yudhya̍ta̱ eko̍ a̱nyac ca̍kṛṣe̱ viśva̍m ānu̱ṣak ||
english: Neither Heaven and Earth have reached the breadth of him, nor have the rivers reached the end of his realm; not even his own rain in the rapture of him fighting — he alone has made all things successive, one after another.

sanskrit: ārca̱nn atra̍ ma̱ruta̱ḥ sasmi̍nn ā̱jau viśve̍ de̱vāso̍ amada̱nn anu̍ tvā | vṛ̱trasya̱ yad bhṛ̍ṣṭi̱matā̍ va̱dhena̱ ni tvam i̍ndra̱ praty ā̱naṁ ja̱ghantha̍ ||
english: Here the Maruts were singing praises in this very battle; all the gods were gladdened following you; when with the pointed weapon, O Indra, you struck down Vṛtra face to face, smiting him down.

sanskrit: ny ū̱3̱̍ ṣu vāca̱m pra ma̱he bha̍rāmahe̱ gira̱ indrā̍ya̱ sada̍ne vi̱vasva̍taḥ | nū ci̱d dhi ratna̍ṁ sasa̱tām i̱vāvi̍da̱n na du̍ṣṭu̱tir dra̍viṇo̱deṣu̍ śasyate ||
english: Now we bring forth speech, carry hymns to the great Indra at the seat of Vivasvat; even now one finds a jewel as if of sleepers — ill praise is not proclaimed at the giving of wealth.

sanskrit: du̱ro aśva̍sya du̱ra i̍ndra̱ gor a̍si du̱ro yava̍sya̱ vasu̍na i̱nas pati̍ḥ | śi̱kṣā̱na̱raḥ pra̱divo̱ akā̍makarśana̱ḥ sakhā̱ sakhi̍bhya̱s tam i̱daṁ gṛ̍ṇīmasi ||
english: You are the door of the horse, the door of the cow, O Indra; the door of barley, the lord and master of wealth; you who from long ago instruct men, who never diminishes those who desire — that friend to friends we now praise.

sanskrit: śacī̍va indra purukṛd dyumattama̱ taved i̱dam a̱bhita̍ś cekite̱ vasu̍ | ata̍ḥ sa̱ṁgṛbhyā̍bhibhūta̱ ā bha̍ra̱ mā tvā̍ya̱to ja̍ri̱tuḥ kāma̍m ūnayīḥ ||
english: O Indra of mighty deeds, doer of many acts, most brilliant — this wealth all around is understood to be yours; therefore seize it, O all-conquering one, and bring it here; do not diminish the desire of the singer who yearns toward you.

sanskrit: e̱bhir dyubhi̍ḥ su̱manā̍ e̱bhir indu̍bhir nirundhā̱no ama̍ti̱ṁ gobhi̍r a̱śvinā̍ | indre̍ṇa̱ dasyu̍ṁ da̱raya̍nta̱ indu̍bhir yu̱tadve̍ṣasa̱ḥ sam i̱ṣā ra̍bhemahi ||
english: With these days, well-minded, with these Soma-drops, keeping darkness away with rays of light, with the two bay-horses; splitting the Dasyu with Indra, with the Soma-drops — may we of active hatred grasp at the impulse together.

sanskrit: sam i̍ndra rā̱yā sam i̱ṣā ra̍bhemahi̱ saṁ vāje̍bhiḥ puruśca̱ndrair a̱bhidyu̍bhiḥ | saṁ de̱vyā prama̍tyā vī̱raśu̍ṣmayā̱ goa̍gra̱yāśvā̍vatyā rabhemahi ||
english: May we grasp together with Indra's wealth, together with impulse, with prizes of many splendors overwhelming the sky; together with the divine great-thought, the heroic-vigored one — may we seize together that which is led by kine and furnished with horses.

sanskrit: te tvā̱ madā̍ amada̱n tāni̱ vṛṣṇyā̱ te somā̍so vṛtra̱hatye̍ṣu satpate | yat kā̱rave̱ daśa̍ vṛ̱trāṇy a̍pra̱ti ba̱rhiṣma̍te̱ ni sa̱hasrā̍ṇi ba̱rhaya̍ḥ ||
english: Those raptures intoxicated you, those virile powers were yours; those Soma-draughts in the slayings of Vṛtra, O lord of good men; when for the singer Kāra you cut down ten Vṛtra-like ones unresisting and thousands for the Soma-strewer.

sanskrit: yu̱dhā yudha̱m upa̱ ghed e̍ṣi dhṛṣṇu̱yā pu̱rā pura̱ṁ sam i̱daṁ ha̱ṁsy oja̍sā | namyā̱ yad i̍ndra̱ sakhyā̍ parā̱vati̍ niba̱rhayo̱ namu̍ci̱ṁ nāma̍ mā̱yina̍m ||
english: Bold you come to battle from battle, fortress by fortress you smash them with force; when in the friendship of Namya in the far distance, O Indra, you slew Namuci, the sorcerer by name.

sanskrit: tvaṁ kara̍ñjam u̱ta pa̱rṇaya̍ṁ vadhī̱s teji̍ṣṭhayātithi̱gvasya̍ varta̱nī | tvaṁ śa̱tā vaṅgṛ̍dasyābhina̱t puro̍ 'nānu̱daḥ pari̍ṣūtā ṛ̱jiśva̍nā ||
english: You slew Karañja and Parṇaya with the sharpest weapon, on the track of Atithigva; you split the hundred fortresses of Vaṅgṛda — irresistible, urged on all sides by Ṛjiśvan.

sanskrit: tvam e̱tāñ ja̍na̱rājño̱ dvir daśā̍ba̱ndhunā̍ su̱śrava̍sopaja̱gmuṣa̍ḥ | ṣa̱ṣṭiṁ sa̱hasrā̍ nava̱tiṁ nava̍ śru̱to ni ca̱kreṇa̱ rathyā̍ du̱ṣpadā̍vṛṇak ||
english: You pinned down those twenty kings of men who had come together against Suśravas, the kinless one; sixty thousand and ninety-nine thousands, O celebrated one, you rolled down with the chariot-wheel — those hard to tread upon.

sanskrit: tvam ā̍vitha su̱śrava̍sa̱ṁ tavo̱tibhi̱s tava̱ trāma̍bhir indra̱ tūrva̍yāṇam | tvam a̍smai̱ kutsa̍m atithi̱gvam ā̱yum ma̱he rājñe̱ yūne̍ arandhanāyaḥ ||
english: You aided Suśravas with your helps, with your protections, O Indra — and Tūrvayāṇa; you gave as allies Kutsa, Atithigva, and Āyu to this young great king.

sanskrit: ya u̱dṛcī̍ndra de̱vago̍pā̱ḥ sakhā̍yas te śi̱vata̍mā̱ asā̍ma | tvāṁ sto̍ṣāma̱ tvayā̍ su̱vīrā̱ drāghī̍ya̱ āyu̍ḥ prata̱raṁ dadhā̍nāḥ ||
english: May we be your most auspicious, god-guarded friends, O Indra, surpassing others; we shall praise you, and with you as our support, full of good heroes, may we hold a longer, more extended life.

sanskrit: mā no̍ a̱smin ma̍ghavan pṛ̱tsv aṁha̍si na̱hi te̱ anta̱ḥ śava̍saḥ parī̱ṇaśe̍ | akra̍ndayo na̱dyo̱3̱̍ roru̍va̱d vanā̍ ka̱thā na kṣo̱ṇīr bhi̱yasā̱ sam ā̍rata ||
english: Do not leave us in distress in these battles, O Maghavan — for there is no end to the encompassing of your might; you made the rivers cry out, you made the forests roar — how would the earthly regions not come together in fear?

sanskrit: arcā̍ śa̱krāya̍ śā̱kine̱ śacī̍vate śṛ̱ṇvanta̱m indra̍m ma̱haya̍nn a̱bhi ṣṭu̍hi | yo dhṛ̱ṣṇunā̱ śava̍sā̱ roda̍sī u̱bhe vṛṣā̍ vṛṣa̱tvā vṛ̍ṣa̱bho nyṛ̱ñjate̍ ||
english: Sing to Śakra, the powerful one, the deed-mighty; honoring the hearing Indra, sing praises; who as a bull, exercising bull-power with bold might, anoints and adorns the two worlds — the bull of bulls.

sanskrit: arcā̍ di̱ve bṛ̍ha̱te śū̱ṣya1̱̍ṁ vaca̱ḥ svakṣa̍tra̱ṁ yasya̍ dhṛṣa̱to dhṛ̱ṣan mana̍ḥ | bṛ̱hacchra̍vā̱ asu̍ro ba̱rhaṇā̍ kṛ̱taḥ pu̱ro hari̍bhyāṁ vṛṣa̱bho ratho̱ hi ṣaḥ ||
english: Sing a vigorous word fit for the great heaven — his whose bold mind is self-sovereign and bold; the Asura of great fame, made mighty by his greatness — for his is the bull-chariot driven forward by the bay steeds.

sanskrit: tvaṁ di̱vo bṛ̍ha̱taḥ sānu̍ kopa̱yo 'va̱ tmanā̍ dhṛṣa̱tā śamba̍ram bhinat | yan mā̱yino̍ vra̱ndino̍ ma̱ndinā̍ dhṛ̱ṣac chi̱tāṁ gabha̍stim a̱śani̍m pṛta̱nyasi̍ ||
english: You set the ridge of great heaven shaking; with bold selfhood you split apart Śambara; when, bold in exhilaration, you attack the sorcerers and the braggers, hurling the sharpened thunderbolt-ray.

sanskrit: ni yad vṛ̱ṇakṣi̍ śvasa̱nasya̍ mū̱rdhani̱ śuṣṇa̍sya cid vra̱ndino̱ roru̍va̱d vanā̍ | prā̱cīne̍na̱ mana̍sā ba̱rhaṇā̍vatā̱ yad a̱dyā ci̍t kṛ̱ṇava̱ḥ kas tvā̱ pari̍ ||
english: When you press down on the head of the snorter, and even the forests roar at the bragging Śuṣṇa; with the forward-moving mind that has its greatness — whatever you do even today, who encompasses you?

sanskrit: tvam ā̍vitha̱ narya̍ṁ tu̱rvaśa̱ṁ yadu̱ṁ tvaṁ tu̱rvīti̍ṁ va̱yya̍ṁ śatakrato | tvaṁ ratha̱m eta̍śa̱ṁ kṛtvye̱ dhane̱ tvam puro̍ nava̱tiṁ da̍mbhayo̱ nava̍ ||
english: You aided the manly Turvaśa and Yadu; you aided Turvīti and Vayya, O hundred-thoughted one; you placed the chariot of Etaśa in the contested prize; you beguiled ninety-nine fortresses.

sanskrit: sa ghā̱ rājā̱ satpa̍tiḥ śūśuva̱j jano̍ rā̱taha̍vya̱ḥ prati̱ yaḥ śāsa̱m inva̍ti | u̱kthā vā̱ yo a̍bhigṛ̱ṇāti̱ rādha̍sā̱ dānu̍r asmā̱ upa̍rā pinvate di̱vaḥ ||
english: That king, the lord of good men, has grown great — the people whose oblations are given, who furthers the command; who responds to the hymns with bounty — for him the upper heavenly stream swells with gifts.

sanskrit: asa̍maṁ kṣa̱tram asa̍mā manī̱ṣā pra so̍ma̱pā apa̍sā santu̱ neme̍ | ye ta̍ indra da̱duṣo̍ va̱rdhaya̍nti̱ mahi̍ kṣa̱traṁ sthavi̍ra̱ṁ vṛṣṇya̍ṁ ca ||
english: Matchless be the lordship, matchless the thought — these Soma-drinkers, let them be foremost with their deed; those who, O Indra, increase the great, firm, and virile sovereignty of the giver.

sanskrit: tubhyed e̱te ba̍hu̱lā adri̍dugdhāś camū̱ṣada̍ś cama̱sā i̍ndra̱pānā̍ḥ | vy a̍śnuhi ta̱rpayā̱ kāma̍m eṣā̱m athā̱ mano̍ vasu̱deyā̍ya kṛṣva ||
english: For you these many cups, milked by the pressing-stone, sitting in the cups made for Indra to drink; enjoy them fully, satiate their desire, and then turn your mind toward giving wealth.

sanskrit: a̱pām a̍tiṣṭhad dha̱ruṇa̍hvara̱ṁ tamo̱ 'ntar vṛ̱trasya̍ ja̱ṭhare̍ṣu̱ parva̍taḥ | a̱bhīm indro̍ na̱dyo̍ va̱vriṇā̍ hi̱tā viśvā̍ anu̱ṣṭhāḥ pra̍va̱ṇeṣu̍ jighnate ||
english: The darkness that calls its supporting frame, the mountain lodged within the belly of Vṛtra, blocked the waters; Indra strikes them downward — all the rivers that were shut in by Vṛtra's coil — along the slopes.

sanskrit: sa śevṛ̍dha̱m adhi̍ dhā dyu̱mnam a̱sme mahi̍ kṣa̱traṁ ja̍nā̱ṣāḻ i̍ndra̱ tavya̍m | rakṣā̍ ca no ma̱ghona̍ḥ pā̱hi sū̱rīn rā̱ye ca̍ naḥ svapa̱tyā i̱ṣe dhā̍ḥ ||
english: O Indra, the most powerful, place upon us the strengthening brightness and the great lordship, the people-conquering; protect us, O Maghavan, guard our patrons, and establish for us wealth, good offspring, and food.

sanskrit: di̱vaś ci̍d asya vari̱mā vi pa̍pratha̱ indra̱ṁ na ma̱hnā pṛ̍thi̱vī ca̱na prati̍ | bhī̱mas tuvi̍ṣmāñ carṣa̱ṇibhya̍ āta̱paḥ śiśī̍te̱ vajra̱ṁ teja̍se̱ na vaṁsa̍gaḥ ||
english: Even the breadth of heaven spread wide — even Earth does not match Indra in greatness; fearful and powerful, he blazes against the peoples; he whets the thunderbolt for brilliance like a forest-bird whets its beak.

sanskrit: so a̍rṇa̱vo na na̱dya̍ḥ samu̱driya̱ḥ prati̍ gṛbhṇāti̱ viśri̍tā̱ varī̍mabhiḥ | indra̱ḥ soma̍sya pī̱taye̍ vṛṣāyate sa̱nāt sa yu̱dhma oja̍sā panasyate ||
english: Like ocean-going rivers, the broad ones, he receives the scattered ones with his expanses; Indra rages like a bull for the drinking of Soma; from of old he, the warrior, is celebrated for his strength.

sanskrit: tvaṁ tam i̍ndra̱ parva̍ta̱ṁ na bhoja̍se ma̱ho nṛ̱mṇasya̱ dharma̍ṇām irajyasi | pra vī̱rye̍ṇa de̱vatāti̍ cekite̱ viśva̍smā u̱graḥ karma̍ṇe pu̱rohi̍taḥ ||
english: You, O Indra, for enjoyment — as it were a mountain — put in motion the laws of great manly power; you are radiant through your heroism beyond the divine measure; fierce, you are the foremost priest for every deed.

sanskrit: sa id vane̍ nama̱syubhi̍r vacasyate̱ cāru̱ jane̍ṣu prabruvā̱ṇa i̍ndri̱yam | vṛṣā̱ chandu̍r bhavati harya̱to vṛṣā̱ kṣeme̍ṇa̱ dhenā̍m ma̱ghavā̱ yad inva̍ti ||
english: He is honored by those who do reverence in the forest, proclaiming Indra's nature beautifully among the peoples; a bull of pleasure, he becomes desirable as a bull; Maghavan is a bull when he impels the cow of prayer in peace.

sanskrit: sa in ma̱hāni̍ sami̱thāni̍ ma̱jmanā̍ kṛ̱ṇoti̍ yu̱dhma oja̍sā̱ jane̍bhyaḥ | adhā̍ ca̱na śrad da̍dhati̱ tviṣī̍mata̱ indrā̍ya̱ vajra̍ṁ ni̱ghani̍ghnate va̱dham ||
english: He performs great battles with his greatness, with his warrior's strength, for the peoples; and then they place faith in the brilliant one — in Indra who ever and again smites with the weapon, the thunderbolt.

sanskrit: sa hi śra̍va̱syuḥ sada̍nāni kṛ̱trimā̍ kṣma̱yā vṛ̍dhā̱na oja̍sā vinā̱śaya̍n | jyotī̍ṁṣi kṛ̱ṇvann a̍vṛ̱kāṇi̱ yajya̱ve 'va̍ su̱kratu̱ḥ sarta̱vā a̱paḥ sṛ̍jat ||
english: For he is fame-seeking; growing great on the earth in strength, he destroys the artificial abodes; creating the lights safe from wolves for the worshipper, the wise-purposed one let loose the waters to flow down.

sanskrit: dā̱nāya̱ mana̍ḥ somapāvann astu te̱ 'rvāñcā̱ harī̍ vandanaśru̱d ā kṛ̍dhi | yami̍ṣṭhāsa̱ḥ sāra̍thayo̱ ya i̍ndra te̱ na tvā̱ ketā̱ ā da̍bhnuvanti̱ bhūrṇa̍yaḥ ||
english: O Soma-drinker, let your mind be for giving; turn your two bay steeds hitherward, hearing the greeting; your most well-reined charioteers, O Indra — the passionate ones do not deceive you, who perceives them.

sanskrit: apra̍kṣita̱ṁ vasu̍ bibharṣi̱ hasta̍yo̱r aṣā̍ḻha̱ṁ saha̍s ta̱nvi̍ śru̱to da̍dhe | āvṛ̍tāso 'va̱tāso̱ na ka̱rtṛbhi̍s ta̱nūṣu̍ te̱ krata̍va indra̱ bhūra̍yaḥ ||
english: You bear in your two hands the inexhaustible wealth; invincible strength is lodged in your body, O celebrated one; those who turn about you like makers turning about wells — in your persons, O Indra, your powers are manifold.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa pra pū̱rvīr ava̱ tasya̍ ca̱mriṣo 'tyo̱ na yoṣā̱m ud a̍yaṁsta bhu̱rvaṇi̍ḥ ||
english: He pushes forth, pressing down many a one of that active-force, active like a steed raising up a woman — he who is agitated; he causes the golden, chariot-laden resource to be yoked with the Hari-horses, richly wrought.

sanskrit: taṁ gū̱rtayo̍ nema̱nniṣa̱ḥ parī̍ṇasaḥ samu̱draṁ na sa̱ṁcara̍ṇe sani̱ṣyava̍ḥ ||
english: To him go the agreeable ones, the full of oblations, the abundant — those about to win, like the meeting-place of the ocean; mount with brilliance over the lord of counsel and might, the ruler of the wide folk.

sanskrit: sa tu̱rvaṇi̍r ma̱hām̐ a̍re̱ṇu pauṁsye̍ gi̱rer bhṛ̱ṣṭir na bhrā̍jate tu̱jā śava̍ḥ ||
english: He is great in conquest, dustless in his manhood, his force gleams like the spike of a mountain; he who by his sorcery-power in exhilaration caused impetuous Śuṣṇa to rest, setting him in bonds though fierce.

sanskrit: de̱vī yadi̱ tavi̍ṣī̱ tvāvṛ̍dho̱taya̱ indra̱ṁ siṣa̍kty u̱ṣasa̱ṁ na sūrya̍ḥ ||
english: If the divine strengthening aid of him who grows through you, O Indra, follows like the sun follows dawn — the one who with bold might pushes away the darkness, who stirs the great dust in the loud resounding.

sanskrit: vi yat ti̱ro dha̱ruṇa̱m acyu̍ta̱ṁ rajo 'ti̍ṣṭhipo di̱va ātā̍su ba̱rhaṇā̍ ||
english: When he stood over the unshaken, supporting realm, traversing the atmospheric space athwart it in his greatness at the stations of heaven; in the intoxication striving for the sun, O Indra, you drove off Vṛtra and pressed out the flood of the waters.

sanskrit: tvaṁ di̱vo dha̱ruṇa̍ṁ dhiṣa̱ oja̍sā pṛthi̱vyā i̍ndra̱ sada̍neṣu̱ māhi̍naḥ | tvaṁ su̱tasya̱ made̍ ariṇā a̱po vi vṛ̱trasya̍ sa̱mayā̍ pā̱ṣyā̍rujaḥ ||
english: You support the foundation of heaven with your power, O Indra, great in the seats of the earth; in the exhilaration of the pressed Soma you released the waters; you broke the banks of Vṛtra all together.

sanskrit: pra maṁhi̍ṣṭhāya bṛha̱te bṛ̱hadra̍ye sa̱tyaśu̍ṣmāya ta̱vase̍ ma̱tim bha̍re | a̱pām i̍va prava̱ṇe yasya̍ du̱rdhara̱ṁ rādho̍ vi̱śvāyu̱ śava̍se̱ apā̍vṛtam ||
english: I bring a thought to the most bounteous, the great one of great wealth, of true vigor, the powerful; whose bounty, all-sustaining, opened for strength and hard to hold back like waters down a slope.

sanskrit: adha̍ te̱ viśva̱m anu̍ hāsad i̱ṣṭaya̱ āpo̍ ni̱mneva̱ sava̍nā ha̱viṣma̍taḥ | yat parva̍te̱ na sa̱maśī̍ta harya̱ta indra̍sya̱ vajra̱ḥ śnathi̍tā hira̱ṇyaya̍ḥ ||
english: Then all the world shall rejoice following your will, the pressings of the oblation-bearer like waters following the downward slope; when the golden thunderbolt of Indra, the desirable one, that pierces and strikes, alights on the mountain.

sanskrit: a̱smai bhī̱māya̱ nama̍sā̱ sam a̍dhva̱ra uṣo̱ na śu̍bhra̱ ā bha̍rā̱ panī̍yase | yasya̱ dhāma̱ śrava̍se̱ nāme̍ndri̱yaṁ jyoti̱r akā̍ri ha̱rito̱ nāya̍se ||
english: Bring with homage at the sacrifice to this fearful, admirable one — bright as the Dawn; whose name-station of renown is Indriya-power — the light was made, the bay steeds are driven onward.

sanskrit: i̱me ta̍ indra̱ te va̱yam pu̍ruṣṭuta̱ ye tvā̱rabhya̱ carā̍masi prabhūvaso | na̱hi tvad a̱nyo gi̍rvaṇo̱ gira̱ḥ sagha̍t kṣo̱ṇīr i̍va̱ prati̍ no harya̱ tad vaca̍ḥ ||
english: These are we, O Indra, much praised — we who move about taking hold of you, O lord of abundant wealth; for no other, O lover of songs, can receive songs as you can — like the earthly regions, accept our speech.

sanskrit: bhūri̍ ta indra vī̱rya1̱̍ṁ tava̍ smasy a̱sya sto̱tur ma̍ghava̱n kāma̱m ā pṛ̍ṇa | anu̍ te̱ dyaur bṛ̍ha̱tī vī̱rya̍m mama i̱yaṁ ca̍ te pṛthi̱vī ne̍ma̱ oja̍se ||
english: Manifold is your heroic power, O Indra — we belong to it; fill the desire of this singer, O Maghavan; the vast heaven follows your heroic power, and this earth bows down to you for your strength.

sanskrit: tvaṁ tam i̍ndra̱ parva̍tam ma̱hām u̱ruṁ vajre̍ṇa vajrin parva̱śaś ca̍kartitha | avā̍sṛjo̱ nivṛ̍tā̱ḥ sarta̱vā a̱paḥ sa̱trā viśva̍ṁ dadhiṣe̱ keva̍la̱ṁ saha̍ḥ ||
english: You, O Indra, O thunderbolt-bearer, cut that great and broad mountain joint by joint with your thunderbolt; you released the waters, held back, to flow; you hold all strength utterly alone.

sanskrit: nū ci̍t saho̱jā a̱mṛto̱ ni tu̍ndate̱ hotā̱ yad dū̱to abha̍vad vi̱vasva̍taḥ | vi sādhi̍ṣṭhebhiḥ pa̱thibhī̱ rajo̍ mama̱ ā de̱vatā̍tā ha̱viṣā̍ vivāsati ||
english: Even now the immortal, born of strength, stirs up — the Hotṛ who became the messenger of Vivasvat; he seeks to gain the divine companionship with oblation, traversing the realm with most direct paths.

sanskrit: ā svam adma̍ yu̱vamā̍no a̱jara̍s tṛ̱ṣv a̍vi̱ṣyann a̍ta̱seṣu̍ tiṣṭhati | atyo̱ na pṛ̱ṣṭham pru̍ṣi̱tasya̍ rocate di̱vo na sānu̍ sta̱naya̍nn acikradat ||
english: The ageless one, ever youthful, eating his own food, eagerly active, stands in the dry places; his back gleams like a steed sprinkled with drops; thundering he has cried out like the ridge of heaven.

sanskrit: krā̱ṇā ru̱drebhi̱r vasu̍bhiḥ pu̱rohi̍to̱ hotā̱ niṣa̍tto rayi̱ṣāḻ ama̍rtyaḥ | ratho̱ na vi̱kṣv ṛ̍ñjasā̱na ā̱yuṣu̱ vy ā̍nu̱ṣag vāryā̍ de̱va ṛ̍ṇvati ||
english: Active together with the Rudras and Vasus, installed as the Purohita, the immortal Hotṛ is seated, the wealth-conquering one; like a chariot adorning itself among the peoples, the god among the living sends forth desirable things one after another.

sanskrit: vi vāta̍jūto ata̱seṣu̍ tiṣṭhate̱ vṛthā̍ ju̱hūbhi̱ḥ sṛṇyā̍ tuvi̱ṣvaṇi̍ḥ ||
english: Wind-impelled, he stands in the dry places, freely spreading his tongues like a scythe, loud-roaring; when, O Agni, you make love to the dry trees, your black track shines brightly, O ageless one of bright waves.

sanskrit: tapu̍rjambho̱ vana̱ ā vāta̍codito yū̱the na sā̱hvām̐ ava̍ vāti̱ vaṁsa̍gaḥ ||
english: Hot-jawed, in the forest, impelled by the wind, blowing down like one calling in a herd, the reed-striker; attacking the unwasting firmament with his might, even the stationary and the moving fear his wings.

sanskrit: da̱dhuṣ ṭvā̱ bhṛga̍vo̱ mānu̍ṣe̱ṣv ā ra̱yiṁ na cāru̍ṁ su̱hava̱ṁ jane̍bhyaḥ | hotā̍ram agne̱ ati̍thi̱ṁ vare̍ṇyam mi̱traṁ na śeva̍ṁ di̱vyāya̱ janma̍ne ||
english: The Bhṛgus established you among men, beautiful like wealth, easy to invoke for the peoples; as Hotṛ, O Agni, a welcome guest, auspicious as a friend, for the heavenly birth.

sanskrit: hotā̍raṁ sa̱pta ju̱hvo̱3̱̍ yaji̍ṣṭha̱ṁ yaṁ vā̱ghato̍ vṛ̱ṇate̍ adhva̱reṣu̍ | a̱gniṁ viśve̍ṣām ara̱tiṁ vasū̍nāṁ sapa̱ryāmi̱ praya̍sā̱ yāmi̱ ratna̍m ||
english: I worship Agni the Hotṛ, the most sacrificial of seven tongues of flame, whom the inspired singers choose at the rites; Agni the intermediary of all the Vasus — I approach with delight and seek the jewel.

sanskrit: acchi̍drā sūno sahaso no a̱dya sto̱tṛbhyo̍ mitramaha̱ḥ śarma̍ yaccha | agne̍ gṛ̱ṇanta̱m aṁha̍sa uru̱ṣyorjo̍ napāt pū̱rbhir āya̍sībhiḥ ||
english: O son of Strength, today extend to us, to the singers, an unbroken shelter, O great as Mitra; O Agni, O offspring of Strength, protect the singer from distress with iron fortresses.

sanskrit: bhavā̱ varū̍thaṁ gṛṇa̱te vi̍bhāvo̱ bhavā̍ maghavan ma̱ghava̍dbhya̱ḥ śarma̍ | u̱ru̱ṣyāgne̱ aṁha̍so gṛ̱ṇanta̍m prā̱tar ma̱kṣū dhi̱yāva̍sur jagamyāt ||
english: Be a refuge to the singer, O brilliant one; be a shelter for the generous to the generous, O Maghavan; O Agni, protect the singer from distress — may the thought-rich one come quickly at dawn.

sanskrit: va̱yā id a̍gne a̱gnaya̍s te a̱nye tve viśve̍ a̱mṛtā̍ mādayante | vaiśvā̍nara̱ nābhi̍r asi kṣitī̱nāṁ sthūṇe̍va̱ janā̍m̐ upa̱mid ya̍yantha ||
english: The other fires are but branches of you, O Agni; all the immortals rejoice in you; you, O Vaiśvānara, are the navel of the peoples — like a pillar you have pervaded the peoples.

sanskrit: mū̱rdhā di̱vo nābhi̍r a̱gniḥ pṛ̍thi̱vyā athā̍bhavad ara̱tī roda̍syoḥ | taṁ tvā̍ de̱vāso̍ 'janayanta de̱vaṁ vaiśvā̍nara̱ jyoti̱r id āryā̍ya ||
english: Agni is the head of heaven, the navel of the earth, and then became the energizing messenger between the two worlds; the gods begot you as a god, O Vaiśvānara — truly a light for the Ārya.

sanskrit: ā sūrye̱ na ra̱śmayo̍ dhru̱vāso̍ vaiśvāna̱re da̍dhire̱ 'gnā vasū̍ni | yā parva̍te̱ṣv oṣa̍dhīṣv a̱psu yā mānu̍ṣe̱ṣv asi̱ tasya̱ rājā̍ ||
english: Like firm rays in the sun, riches are deposited in Vaiśvānara Agni; those that are in mountains, in plants, in waters — of those riches in men you are king.

sanskrit: bṛ̱ha̱tī i̍va sū̱nave̱ roda̍sī̱ giro̱ hotā̍ manu̱ṣyo̱3̱̍ na dakṣa̍ḥ | sva̍rvate sa̱tyaśu̍ṣmāya pū̱rvīr vai̍śvāna̱rāya̱ nṛta̍māya ya̱hvīḥ ||
english: Like the vast heaven and earth to their son, the hymns — the Hotṛ of humans, skilled as a sage; many and young hymns for the sun-possessing, truly vigorous Vaiśvānara, the most manly one.

sanskrit: di̱vaś ci̍t te bṛha̱to jā̍tavedo̱ vaiśvā̍nara̱ pra ri̍rice mahi̱tvam | rājā̍ kṛṣṭī̱nām a̍si̱ mānu̍ṣīṇāṁ yu̱dhā de̱vebhyo̱ vari̍vaś cakartha ||
english: Even from great heaven, O Jātavedas, your greatness surpasses, O Vaiśvānara; you are king of the human peoples; in battle you have made wide space for the gods.

sanskrit: pra nū ma̍hi̱tvaṁ vṛ̍ṣa̱bhasya̍ voca̱ṁ yam pū̱ravo̍ vṛtra̱haṇa̱ṁ saca̍nte | vai̱śvā̱na̱ro dasyu̍m a̱gnir ja̍gha̱nvām̐ adhū̍no̱t kāṣṭhā̱ ava̱ śamba̍ram bhet ||
english: Now I shall proclaim the greatness of the bull whom the Pūrus accompany as the Vṛtra-slayer; Vaiśvānara Agni, having slain the Dasyu, shook loose the firesticks, split apart Śambara.

sanskrit: vai̱śvā̱na̱ro ma̍hi̱mnā vi̱śvakṛ̍ṣṭir bha̱radvā̍jeṣu yaja̱to vi̱bhāvā̍ | śā̱ta̱va̱ne̱ye śa̱tinī̍bhir a̱gniḥ pu̍ruṇī̱the ja̍rate sū̱nṛtā̍vān ||
english: Vaiśvānara, of all peoples by his greatness, the adorable, self-brilliant one, is to be worshipped among the Bharadvājas; Agni, the truth-speaking one, is praised with hundredfold songs at the Śātavaneyī, at the many-named one.

sanskrit: vahni̍ṁ ya̱śasa̍ṁ vi̱datha̍sya ke̱tuṁ su̍prā̱vya̍ṁ dū̱taṁ sa̱dyoa̍rtham | dvi̱janmā̍naṁ ra̱yim i̍va praśa̱staṁ rā̱tim bha̍ra̱d bhṛga̍ve māta̱riśvā̍ ||
english: The carrier, the glorious, the banner of the assembly, the easily invocable, the messenger who brings immediate purpose; the double-born one, praised like a treasure — Mātariśvan brought this gift to Bhṛgu.

sanskrit: a̱sya śāsu̍r u̱bhayā̍saḥ sacante ha̱viṣma̍nta u̱śijo̱ ye ca̱ martā̍ḥ | di̱vaś ci̱t pūrvo̱ ny a̍sādi̱ hotā̱pṛcchyo̍ vi̱śpati̍r vi̱kṣu ve̱dhāḥ ||
english: Both kinds attend on his command — those who bear oblations, both the inspired poets and the mortals; even foremost among those of heaven he was set down as the Hotṛ, the worthy of question, the lord of the folk, the ordainer among the settlements.

sanskrit: taṁ navya̍sī hṛ̱da ā jāya̍mānam a̱smat su̍kī̱rtir madhu̍jihvam aśyāḥ ||
english: May our fair praise reach him ever newly born in the heart — the honey-tongued one; whom the priests, the human Āyus pressing the Soma in the enclosed space, begetting, brought to birth.

sanskrit: u̱śik pā̍va̱ko vasu̱r mānu̍ṣeṣu̱ vare̍ṇyo̱ hotā̍dhāyi vi̱kṣu | damū̍nā gṛ̱hapa̍ti̱r dama̱ ām̐ a̱gnir bhu̍vad rayi̱patī̍ rayī̱ṇām ||
english: The sage, the purifier, the good one among humans, the choiceworthy Hotṛ was placed among the settlements; the dweller in the house, the householder at home — may Agni become master of riches, lord of wealth.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā̍ va̱yam pati̍m agne rayī̱ṇām pra śa̍ṁsāmo ma̱tibhi̱r gota̍māsaḥ | ā̱śuṁ na vā̍jambha̱ram ma̱rjaya̍ntaḥ prā̱tar ma̱kṣū dhi̱yāva̍sur jagamyāt ||
english: You as master of riches, O Agni — we the Gotamas praise you with our thoughts; grooming you like a swift prize-winner — may the thought-rich one come quickly at dawn.
